description:
Powerful Performances: Say goodbye to frequent recharges! The A1 is equipped with a robust 48V 14Ah battery that provides a maximum range of 50KM on a single charge without worrying about running out of power. With a 500W motor, it delivers an exhilarating ride effortlessly reaching speeds of up to 25 km/h (actual driving speed is affected by terrain, rider weight, tire pressure, wind speed, etc.).

Intelligent and Portable: Connected via Bluetooth to a dedicated app and featuring an intuitive LED display, the A1 keeps essential information at your fingertips, from battery status to speed and more. With an easy-to-use folding mechanism, it measures only 129*65*64 cm when folded, weighing just 26.85KG. It can be your ideal mode of transportation for commuting to school, work, or a short adventure.

Smooth Riding Experience: Equipped with innovative front hydraulic spring suspension and reliable rear spring suspension, the A1 confidently navigates diverse terrains. Thanks to the robust 10*2.75 honeycomb solid tires at the front and rear, you'll glide over bumps and uneven surfaces effortlessly, enjoying a smooth and controlled ride every time.

Advanced Braking and Safety: Featuring front drum brakes, the A1 provides precise control over your ride. Experience the confidence of quick and efficient braking, complemented by the additional safety of handlebar-controlled motor disengagement for instant braking power. Made from a sturdy aluminum alloy, it strikes the perfect balance between lightweight design and robustness.

After-Sales Warranty: The A1 electric scooter comes with an instruction manual and installation tools. No worries about assembly. If you encounter any issues with the EVERCROSS electric scooter, feel free to contact us, and we will provide you with 100% satisfactory after-sales service.
